scope: s59 (GPU AUROC tie disclosure), s60 (monotone PCA share + per-seed crossing), s56 (fixed-reference rewrite), s54/s55/s37/s42 text corrections

gt_provenance.details: Membership GT is a 3-way disjoint per-group random split of real 1000G genotypes (s48 cohort_cell, s56 cell, s60 share_ladder); s54 reproduces s48's statistic to all printed digits; s37/s42 proxy arms are labeled.

score_normalization.details: s60's denominator is the total squared norm about the study mean (an input statistic), not model output. But the cumulative squared-projection share is monotone BY CONSTRUCTION (cumsum of non-negative increments); the paper initially cited its monotonicity as if it certified a gap. Reworded to state it only rules out a share that rises by construction.

result_existence.details: All headline numbers trace to live JSON keys. Two quoted statements contradicted their JSONs and were fixed: (i) s42 'differ by <=0.01 / bounded above by candonly' (actual diff 0.0212 at rho=0.25 and table>candonly at rho=0.75); (ii) s56 'up to sd 0.26' (actual max 0.41). Also 'rather than all eighteen' -> the s48 ladder has 19 cohorts. All corrected in paper/docs.

dead_code.details: s59/s60 functions all called and reach JSON. s60 line 96 assigns crossing.mean from mean_sequence[0] then overwritten by the per-seed mean; harmless, mean_sequence preserved in JSON.
